title: Your Own Exception
statementMd:
Real systems define their own exceptions so callers know exactly what went wrong. `withdraw` must throw an **InsufficientFundsException** (a checked exception, already declared for you) when the amount is more than the balance, carrying how much is missing.

`main` is written: it catches the exception and prints the shortfall.

**Input**
Line 1: the opening balance. Line 2: `q`. Then q amounts to withdraw.

**Output**
One line per withdrawal: `Paid <amount>` or `Short by <amount>`. Finally `Balance: <balance>`.
hints: throw new InsufficientFundsException(amount - balance); when the amount is too big.
Nothing after a throw runs, so subtract from the balance only in the normal case.

testCases.expectedOutput:
Paid 10
Paid 10
Paid 10
Short by 80
Balance: 20
